topic: Food Webs and Roles of Organisms
key_concepts: Producers are autotrophs that capture energy from the Sun and make their own food.
Consumers are heterotrophs that cannot make their own food and must eat other organisms.

Scavengers feed on dead animals and help remove carcasses that could harbor diseases.
Decomposers break down dead plants and animals and return nutrients to the soil.
Energy flows from the Sun to producers through photosynthesis.
Energy is lost as heat at each trophic level during digestion and respiration.
